name: aidrian-harness
description: Shared AI harness for Claude Code and Codex: agents, skills, and a knowledge-bucket contract

scripts.check: node scripts/build.mjs --check && node plugins/aidrian/lib/cli.mjs check --project examples/consumer && npm run lint && node --test
scripts.lint: node plugins/aidrian/lib/cli.mjs lint skills plugins/aidrian/skills && node plugins/aidrian/lib/cli.mjs lint agents plugins/aidrian/agents && node plugins/aidrian/lib/cli.mjs lint paths && node plugins/aidrian/lib/cli.mjs lint --project examples/consumer
